agent_registration.entry_point: User-directed: bring the asfdk-harness source into nlt-pi's MVP so the governed turn can be built and tested on Vercel. The harness previously ran only against a local Pi copy on one of the owner's machines.
agent_registration.scope: Vendor the subset of asfdk-harness/src required by mvp/src/index.ts into the MVP boundary with provenance headers, declare its real dependencies, make the MVP typecheck and tests pass, and prepare (but not perform without approval) a Vercel test. No change to policy.ts or governance behavior; no credentials, persistence, provider, or production deployment decisions.
capabilities_self_reported: Repository inspection across nlt-pi, asfdk-harness, asfdk, nlt-coding-agent
Local file edits, npm install, typecheck and test execution in the cloud container
Git branch commits and draft pull request creation via GitHub MCP
known_limitations: Cannot run Pi on the owner's local machine; harness behavior there is not reproduced.
No Vercel credentials or deployment authority; any deployment requires explicit human approval.
Cloud container network access is proxied; registry access may differ from the owner's machines.
